status: test parameters, not a deployment manifest or supported-hardware claim
optional_aesgcm: disabled; requires separate build and evidence

esp32s3.abi: Xtensa ESP32-S3, 32-bit little-endian, SDK toolchain ABI

memory.mutable: internal DRAM; IDF dram0_0_seg; no PSRAM
memory.code: flash-mapped text/rodata; required IRAM charged to RAM envelope

memory.mutable: single internal SRAM region; budget only, no board address assumed
memory.linking: archive-only until an explicit board/linker map is selected

cortex_m4.provider_build_and_measurement: pending; only C11 scaffold object compiled

measurement_rules.budget_scope: each RAM and linked-flash envelope applies to one endpoint instance; never sum the RAM of remote endpoints against one envelope
measurement_rules.sensitivity_counts_scope: peers, services, active/draining associations, pending attempts, crypto slots and application operations are totals per endpoint, not per role or mode
measurement_rules.sweep: each row against each envelope; roles/modes separately and coexisting within one endpoint, charged to the same total; remote endpoints evaluated independently; not yet executed
measurement_rules.return_zero: continuous availability; values are future harness sensitivity inputs, not a validated radio schedule
measurement_rules.ram_scope: include pending/active/draining state, setup allocator overhead, pools, simultaneous scratch/stacks, TX/RX/cache/retry/result/rejection buffers, adapter/DMA and control reserve; shared buffers counted once only with proven exclusive lifetime
measurement_rules.flash_scope: linked DMP plus provider/backend contribution including required rodata; report SDK base separately
measurement_rules.unimplemented_components: report missing, never zero; provider-only results cannot pass the whole DMP envelope
measurement_rules.overrun: mark that experimental combination infeasible; do not silently increase a budget
measurement_rules.ownership: one serialized owner per Noise state; concurrent slots require distinct states and scratch
measurement_rules.cpu_stack_energy: host timing and compiler stack reports are separate from MCU high-water/CPU/energy measurements
measurement_rules.production_freeze: P03 only after P01; no product minimum or latency guarantee selected here
